parameters.name: runmode
parameters.description: runmode (case-insensitive). Valid values: ON-DEMAND, INCREMENTAL, OPMODE

parameters.name: threshold
parameters.description: Threshold value filter used to process partition with user specified channel threshold value

parameters.name: delay
parameters.description: Delay the deployment of solution in minutes; Range [0-360], default 0

parameters.name: window
parameters.description: Deploy Window in minutes; Range [0-360], default 120

get.summary: Get solver optimizations for a given tenant
get.description: Returns the list of solver optimizations/solutions generated by Airmatch for a given tenant. This endpoint supports multiple query parameters to filter and paginate the list of solutions returned. If no query parameters are provided, it will return all solutions for the tenant up to the default pagination limit.

parameters.name: start-at
parameters.description: Filter for solutions with timestamp greater than or equal to the provided timestamp

parameters.name: end-at
parameters.description: Filter for solutions with timestamp less than or equal to the provided timestamp

parameters.name: runmode
parameters.description: Runmode Filter to return solutions for that runmode. Valid values are SCHEDULE, ON-DEMAND, INCREMENTAL, OPMODE, and EIRP.

parameters.name: rf-domain-id
parameters.description: RF Domain ID filter to return solutions for radios in a specific rf domain

parameters.name: rf-partition-id
parameters.description: RF Partition ID filter to return solutions for radios in a specific rf partition

parameters.name: band-selected
parameters.description: Radio band filter to return solutions for radios in a specific band

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Request ID Filter to return specific solution using request id provided by user in query parameter

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: Filters solution documents based on deployment status field. Valid values are COMPUTED, SENT, RETRIED, DEPLOY_UNSUCCESSFUL, and CONFIRMED.
